_note: The same set after human QA review (fictional). Changes: invented TC-003 rejected and removed; boundary and AC-4 cases added; open question resolved.

cases.title: REEFER row with a valid temperature is accepted

steps.action: Upload a file with one REEFER row and temperature_c = -18
steps.expected: Row is accepted with no errors

cases.title: REEFER row without temperature is rejected

steps.action: Upload a REEFER row with temperature_c empty

cases.title: VAN row with a temperature is accepted with a warning

steps.action: Upload a VAN row with temperature_c = 4
steps.expected: Row is accepted; TEMPERATURE_NOT_APPLICABLE warning in the row report

openQuestions: Should the warning appear in the summary or only in the row report?

review.notes: Product owner confirmed: row report only.

cases.title: Temperature exactly at -25 and 8 is accepted; -25.1 and 8.1 are rejected

steps.action: Upload REEFER rows with temperature_c -25, 8, -25.1 and 8.1
steps.expected: -25 and 8 accepted; -25.1 and 8.1 rejected with OUT_OF_RANGE

review.notes: Added in review: the draft had no boundary case.

cases.title: Rejection names the row number and the column

steps.action: Upload a file whose third data row is a REEFER row without temperature
steps.expected: The report shows row 4 (header is row 1) and column temperature_c

review.notes: Added in review: AC-4 was not covered.

cases.title: A TRUCK row with an out-of-range temperature is still rejected

steps.action: Upload a TRUCK row with temperature_c = -30 (outside the reefer range)
steps.expected: Row is rejected with OUT_OF_RANGE: the range applies to any value given

review.notes: Edge between AC-2 and AC-3 confirmed against the validator: range is checked whenever a value is present.
